about: Household questions for the on-demand context eval (knowledge_eval.py). Each names the tool a model should call first when the answer is not in the prompt (null: answer directly, no tool), any argument the call must carry, and the collections the pre-fetch may read (an empty list: none). Generic wording only: no household names, devices or addresses.
